scope: Two replacement full menu tracks after rejection of the earlier synthwave-like pair. User explicitly requested both full tracks.

requests.name: Emergency Shift — Sublevel Signal — Reference Study 02
requests.prompt: Original instrumental title-menu music in the stylistic territory of Alien Shooter (2003) Menu Theme: bleak, uncanny, hypnotic dark ambient / industrial downtempo game soundtrack, a sinister enclosed laboratory atmosphere. Early-2000s sampler aesthetics and raw electronic sound design. A full-length composition with a distinctive short recurring theme and patiently unfolding layers. Slow 70 BPM in 4/4, recurring four-bar phrase, C tonal center and a dark minor/modal color. Use a hollow organ-like sampled electronic layer as a dark supporting voice, rather than warm synthesizer pads. In the central section the percussion has a very slow gritty trip-hop / downtempo character with broken syncopation, not an 80s pop beat. Start sparse and eerie: thin hollow sustained tones, distant ambiguous noise, a cold rounded sonar-like melodic note answered by a short bell/mallet-like phrase. Keep this simple, uneasy and repetitive, with long gaps between statements. Slowly introduce a deep steady low tonal foundation, not a sequenced synth bass riff. After a substantial atmospheric opening introduce a restrained uneven low rhythmic pattern: muted heavy thuds, dry dusty sampled clicks and thin metallic accents, never a bright dancing beat. Develop tension by adding and removing spectral layers around the same memorable motif; the composition should feel haunted and unsafe even at low intensity. Quietly distorted low-mid sound and grainy narrow-band higher textures, a few unstable hovering notes and brief falling pitches; keep the darkness and the spaces. Open up the arrangement in steps rather than a pop build. Sustain a low-intensity but oppressive central passage, thin it briefly and return to the central motif, then leave an understated ending near the initial texture. The music must carry the uncanny dread of an old horror game's title screen. No vocals or speech. Exclude synthwave, retrowave, outrun, new-age relaxation, space meditation, romantic film-score harmony, lush warm pads, glossy supersaw chord beds, continuous eighth-note arpeggiators, upbeat bass ostinatos, four-on-the-floor kicks, gated 1980s snare, pumping sidechain, EDM risers/drops, heroic trailer swells, rock guitar leads, jazz organ playing or busy percussion. The work must have original notes and phrasing; do not quote the reference melody. Aim for the same sparse eerie sampler-based character rather than a generic modern sci-fi synth track.

requests.name: Emergency Shift — Below the Ward — Reference Study 02
requests.prompt: Original instrumental title-menu music in the stylistic territory of Alien Shooter 2 (2006) Main Theme: ominous dark ambient electronica moving into restrained industrial downtempo / slow broken-beat rhythm. Early-2000s PC horror game soundtrack, haunting, claustrophobic and hypnotic, with a strong recurring simple musical identity. Full-length developed instrumental, around 90 BPM, 4/4, clear repeating four-bar figure. Stable low F tonal pedal with an open F-C fifth and sparse minor/modal melodic shading; leave thirds ambiguous, avoid a constant lush chord progression. Begin with a long unhurried dark atmospheric introduction: low sustained foundation and a thin distant keyboard/organ-like sustained electronic timbre, never a bright organ performance. Above it, a short cold simple melody, slightly uneven and detuned, repeats with small variations and long spaces. Around the first third gradually expose higher thin sharp attacks and an eerie quiet counter-texture; only later, toward the middle, introduce heavier low rhythmic attacks and a dusty slow trip-hop / downtempo sampled drum pattern with broken syncopation, subdued snare-like clicks and narrow metallic percussion. Keep the bass ominous and sustained, distinguish it from the drum impacts. Maintain a steady dark central section over the recurring figure without turning into an action anthem. Late in the piece, strip away almost all low rhythmic weight for a real sparse breakdown; let the eerie motif hang, then bring back the same low groove and motif for a final passage. Restrained, cold, coarse and threatening sound rather than polished or comforting. No voices, lyrics, literal hospital alarms or gunshots. Exclude synthwave, retrowave, outrun, 1980s nostalgia, new-age music, relaxing space ambience, shimmering warm analog pads, glossy supersaw harmony, cheerful or romantic melody, perpetual arpeggiators, funky basslines, four-on-the-floor dance rhythm, pumping sidechain, modern dubstep wobble bass, EDM drops and risers, trailer orchestral climax or rock guitar solo. The keyboard-like texture should be spectral and uncanny, the percussion dry and mechanical, the melody sparse and memorable. Compose original notes and phrasing rather than copying any existing tune.
